item.title: MCP: Enabling Controlled & Composable AI Systems
item.description:
Author: The Lasso Team
Date: December 28, 2025
Tags: ["Artificial Intelligence", "Large Language Models", "API Integration", "Software Standards", "Automation"]
Summary:
  • MCP is an open standard for connecting LLMs to external systems.
  • It enables structured discovery of tools and context retrieval.
  • MCP reduces reliance on custom integrations and improvised wrappers.
  • It provides a predictable interface for managing model behavior.
  • MCP supports more reliable and composable AI workflows.
